put.description:
Diagnostic of an ActionPolicy will indicate if the actions are suspended or not, and the reason why.

When the action leads to too many failures (for example Http Push with 5xx responses, FIFO never subbed...) the platform will automatically suspend the action.

Once suspended, you can use the resume API to re-enable the action. Please note that if the underlying issue is not fixed, the action will be suspended again.

Usage of this API will be reported in your access log under 'routing' category.

Restricted to API keys with at least one of the following roles: DATA_PROCESSING_W.

Request body.description: Use 'false' in the request body to resume a suspended action.

get.summary: retrieve a geozone from repository
get.description:
The Geozone repository is a database that allows storing geographical sites/zones of interest. The geozones are stored as polygons (array of geopoints coordinates in decimal degrees). Meta information like a description and tags can be stored with the geozone. The Geozone format : coordinates for polygon definition, use longitude as the first coordinate and latitude as the second coordinate, polygons are closed linestrings, with at least four coordinate pairs and specify the same position as the first and last coordinates. You can define several polygons in the same geozone, for example to define a zone with holes (first polygon is the external limit of the zone and the following polygons are holes in this zone). e.g. [[[1.780892, 48.091452], [2.301382, 48.000565], [2.281961, 47.509630], [1.252634, 47.729556], [1.780892, 48.091452]]]

Restricted to API keys with at least one of the following roles: DATA_PROCESSING_R.

parameters.name: zoneId
parameters.description: the user-defined id of the zone to retrieve

404.description: Unable to find specified geozone id

Provides aggregation and counting capabilities over the entire fleet inventory index. It is intended for dashboards, analytics, and reporting where you need counts and distributions rather than individual device details.

RSQL supported fields are:

  • "id": device identifier
  • "group.path": group path
  • "group.id": group identifier
  • "tags": tags
  • "properties.k": properties key
  • "properties.v": properties value
  • "properties": properties (associated with =q= operator)
    • Ex: properties=q='k==myKey and v==myValue'
    • Ex: properties=q='k=="my key" and v==myValue'
  • "property.": properties (associated with key value, the key must contain only alphanumeric characters and '_')
    • Ex: property.myKey==myValue
  • "interfaces": interface (associated with =q= operator)
  • "interfaces.connector": interface connector type (Ex: sms, lora, mqtt)
  • "interfaces.nodeId": interface node identifier
  • "interfaces.enabled": interface state (true or false)
  • "interfaces.status": interface status (REGISTERED, INITIALIZING, INITIALIZED, REACTIVATED, ONLINE, ACTIVATED, OFFLINE, SLEEPING, DEACTIVATED, CONNECTIVITY_ERROR, UNKNOWN)

  • "activities": activities (associated with =q= operator)
  • "activities.ruleId": activities rule identifier
  • "activities.state": activities state (UNKNOWN, SILENT, ACTIVE)

  • "==": equality
  • "==*": equality with prefix

  • "!=": difference
  • "=q=''": equality only for activity, interfaces, properties fields

  • "and"
  • ";": identical to and operator

  • ",": identical to or operator

get.summary: Get the interface list for a registered device
get.description:
A device can hold several nodes, each one defining a connectivity - LoRa, MQTT, LwM2M, SMS, X-Connector - of this device.

The definition depends on connector.

Lora definition:

  • "devEUI": interface EUI
  • "appEUI": appEUI of the interface
  • "appKey": appKey of the interface
  • "activationType": supported value: "OTAA"
  • "profile": profile of the interface
  • "encoding": (Optional) encoding used in message's payload (use /decoders APIs to define your own decoder)
  • "connectivityOptions": connectivity options used for the interface
    • "location": true/false
    • "ackUl": true/false
  • "connectivityPlan": connectivity plan to use for the interface. Should be used preferably at connectivityOptions but at least one of two shall be defined.

SMS definition:

  • "msisdn": interface phone number. Expected phone number is an international phone number : 6..15 digits starting with country code (ex. '33') and without international prefix (ex. '00'). Dummy examples of phone numbers:
    • Belgium: 32654332211
    • France: 33654332211
    • Spain: 34654332211
    • Romania: 40654332211
    • Slovakia: 421654332211
  • "serverPhoneNumber": (Optional) server phone number
  • "encoding": (Optional) name of the decoder that will be used to decode received SMS


MQTT definition:

  • "clientId": interface client ID
  • "encoding": (Optional) encoding used in message's payload (use /decoders APIs to define your own decoder)

X-CONNECTOR definition:

  • "nodeId": id used by the external connector to identify the communicating device (e.g. PUB connector/v1/nodes/{nodeId}/status)
  • "encoding": (Optional) encoding used in message's payload (use /decoders APIs to define your own decoder)

LwM2M definition:

  • "endpointName": the endpoint client name. Must comply to the format of a nodeId.
  • "security": the security information. Mandatory in creation if node is not Bootstrap managed (must be null if it is Bootstrap managed). Updated as a whole during a PATCH.
    • "mode": the security mode. Example: PSK (case sensitive)
    • "pskInfo": the pre-shared key information. Mandatory in PSK mode. Must be null in other security modes.
      • "identity": the PSK identity. Its maximum size is 128 bytes.
      • "secret": the pre-shared secret key. Must be between 16 bytes and 64 bytes and encoded in hexadecimal.
  • "bootstrap": the bootstrap information. Optional. Updated as a whole during a PATCH.
    • "managed": if true, the 'security' info will be managed by the LwM2M bootstrap operation.
  • "encoding": (Optional) encoding used in message's payload (use /decoders APIs to define your own decoder)

The activity depends on connector.

Lora activity:

  • "lastActivationTs": (Optional) last activation date of the interface
  • "lastDeactivationTs": (Optional) last deactivation date of the interface
  • "lastSignalLevel": (Optional) last signal level. " This value is a signal level computed from last uplink.
  • "avgSignalLevel": (Optional) average signal level. " This value is a signal level computed from uplinks history (PER+SNR+ESP quality indicators aggregate). " On frame counter reset, the uplinks history and average signal level are reset.
  • "lastBatteryLevel": (Optional) last battery level
  • "lastBatteryLevelTs": (Optional) date of the last battery level
  • "lastDlFcnt": (Optional) last downlink frame counter
  • "lastUlFcnt": (Optional) last uplink frame counter

SMS activity:

  • "lastUplink": (Optional) last uplink date of the interface
    • "timestamp": date of the activity
    • "serverPhoneNumber": server phone number used
  • "lastDownlink": (Optional) last downlink date of the connector node
    • "timestamp": date of the activity
    • "serverPhoneNumber": server phone number used

MQTT activity:

  • "apiKeyId": api key ID used
  • "mqttVersion": mqtt version used
  • "mqttUsername": mqtt username used
  • "mqttTimeout": mqtt timeout
  • "remoteAddress"

post.summary: Add an interface to a registered device
post.description:
A device can hold several nodes, each one defining a connectivity - LoRa, MQTT, LwM2M, SMS, X-Connector - of this device.

The definition depends on connector.

Lora definition:

  • "devEUI": interface EUI
  • "appEUI": appEUI of the interface
  • "appKey": appKey of the interface
  • "activationType": supported value: "OTAA"
  • "profile": profile of the interface
  • "encoding": (Optional) encoding used in message's payload (use /decoders APIs to define your own decoder)
  • "connectivityOptions": connectivity options used for the interface
    • "location": true/false
    • "ackUl": true/false
  • "connectivityPlan": connectivity plan to use for the interface. Should be used preferably at connectivityOptions but at least one of two shall be defined.

SMS definition:

  • "msisdn": interface phone number. Expected phone number is an international phone number : 6..15 digits starting with country code (ex. '33') and without international prefix (ex. '00'). Dummy examples of phone numbers:
    • Belgium: 32654332211
    • France: 33654332211
    • Spain: 34654332211
    • Romania: 40654332211
    • Slovakia: 421654332211
  • "serverPhoneNumber": (Optional) server phone number
  • "encoding": (Optional) name of the decoder that will be used to decode received SMS


MQTT definition:

  • "clientId": interface client ID
  • "encoding": (Optional) encoding used in message's payload (use /decoders APIs to define your own decoder)

X-CONNECTOR definition:

  • "nodeId": id used by the external connector to identify the communicating device (e.g. PUB connector/v1/nodes/{nodeId}/status)
  • "encoding": (Optional) encoding used in message's payload (use /decoders APIs to define your own decoder)

LwM2M definition:

  • "endpointName": the endpoint client name. Must comply to the format of a nodeId.
  • "security": the security information. Mandatory in creation if node is not Bootstrap managed (must be null if it is Bootstrap managed). Updated as a whole during a PATCH.
    • "mode": the security mode. Example: PSK (case sensitive)
    • "pskInfo": the pre-shared key information. Mandatory in PSK mode. Must be null in other security modes.
      • "identity": the PSK identity. Its maximum size is 128 bytes.
      • "secret": the pre-shared secret key. Must be between 16 bytes and 64 bytes and encoded in hexadecimal.
  • "bootstrap": the bootstrap information. Optional. Updated as a whole during a PATCH.
    • "managed": if true, the 'security' info will be managed by the LwM2M bootstrap operation.
  • "encoding": (Optional) encoding used in message's payload (use /decoders APIs to define your own decoder)

get.description:
A device can hold several nodes, each one defining a connectivity - LoRa, MQTT, LwM2M, SMS, X-Connector - of this device.

The definition depends on connector.

Lora definition:

  • "appEUI": appEUI of the interface
  • "appKey": appKey of the interface
  • "activationType": supported value: "OTAA"
  • "profile": profile of the interface
  • "encoding": (Optional) encoding used in message's payload (use /decoders APIs to define your own decoder)
  • "connectivityOptions": connectivity options used for the interface
    • "location": true/false
    • "ackUl": true/false
  • "connectivityPlan": connectivity plan to use for the interface. Should be used preferably at connectivityOptions but at least one of two shall be defined.

SMS definition:

  • "msisdn": interface phone number. Expected phone number is an international phone number : 6..15 digits starting with country code (ex. '33') and without international prefix (ex. '00'). Dummy examples of phone numbers:
    • Belgium: 32654332211
    • France: 33654332211
    • Spain: 34654332211
    • Romania: 40654332211
    • Slovakia: 421654332211
  • "serverPhoneNumber": (Optional) server phone number
  • "encoding": (Optional) name of the decoder that will be used to decode received SMS


MQTT definition:

  • "clientId": interface client ID
  • "encoding": (Optional) encoding used in message's payload (use /decoders APIs to define your own decoder)

X-CONNECTOR definition:

  • "nodeId": id used by the external connector to identify the communicating device (e.g. PUB connector/v1/nodes/{nodeId}/status)
  • "encoding": (Optional) encoding used in message's payload (use /decoders APIs to define your own decoder)

LwM2M definition:

  • "endpointName": the endpoint client name. Must comply to the format of a nodeId.
  • "security": the security information. Mandatory in creation if node is not Bootstrap managed (must be null if it is Bootstrap managed). Updated as a whole during a PATCH.
    • "mode": the security mode. Example: PSK (case sensitive)
    • "pskInfo": the pre-shared key information. Mandatory in PSK mode. Must be null in other security modes.
      • "identity": the PSK identity. Its maximum size is 128 bytes.
      • "secret": the pre-shared secret key. Must be between 16 bytes and 64 bytes and encoded in hexadecimal.
  • "bootstrap": the bootstrap information. Optional. Updated as a whole during a PATCH.
    • "managed": if true, the 'security' info will be managed by the LwM2M bootstrap operation.
  • "encoding": (Optional) encoding used in message's payload (use /decoders APIs to define your own decoder)

The activity depends on connector.

Lora activity:

  • "lastActivationTs": (Optional) last activation date of the interface
  • "lastDeactivationTs": (Optional) last deactivation date of the interface
  • "lastSignalLevel": (Optional) last signal level. " This value is a signal level computed from last uplink.
  • "avgSignalLevel": (Optional) average signal level. " This value is a signal level computed from uplinks history (PER+SNR+ESP quality indicators aggregate). " On frame counter reset, the uplinks history and average signal level are reset.
  • "lastBatteryLevel": (Optional) last battery level
  • "lastBatteryLevelTs": (Optional) date of the last battery level
  • "lastDlFcnt": (Optional) last downlink frame counter
  • "lastUlFcnt": (Optional) last uplink frame counter

SMS activity:

  • "lastUplink": (Optional) last uplink date of the interface
    • "timestamp": date of the activity
    • "serverPhoneNumber": server phone number used
  • "lastDownlink": (Optional) last downlink date of the connector node
    • "timestamp": date of the activity
    • "serverPhoneNumber": server phone number used

MQTT activity:

  • "apiKeyId": api key ID used
  • "mqttVersion": mqtt version used
  • "mqttUsername": mqtt username used
  • "mqttTimeout": mqtt timeout
  • "remoteAddress"
  • "lastSessionStartTime"
  • "lastSessionEndTime"
  • "security": security information
    • "secured":true/false
    • "protocol":(Optional) security protocol used (ex: TLSv1.2)
    • "cipher": (Optional) cipher suite (ex: TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256)
    • "clientCertAuthentication": (Optional) true/false
    • "sniHostname": (Optional) hostname provided by the Server Name Indication extension

LwM2M activity:

  • "lwm2mVersion": version of LwM2M protocol used
  • "remoteAddress": last IP used to connect to LiveObjects
  • "remotePort": last port used to connect to LiveObjects
  • "queueMode": indicator of queueMode usage
  • "bindings": last bindings parameters used
  • "registrationLifetime": registration lifetime used
  • "lastRegistrationDate": last 'Register' date
  • "lastDeregistrationDate": last 'Deregister' date
  • "lastUpdateDate": last 'Update' date
  • "lastBootstrapProvisioningDate": last time the device definition was updated by the LiveObjects bootstrap server

Note: get command are not allowed for X-Connector.

get.summary: List all connector nodes
get.description:
A device can hold several nodes, each one defining a connectivity - LoRa, MQTT, LwM2M, SMS, X-Connector - of this device.

The definition depends on connector.

Lora definition:

  • "devEUI": interface EUI
  • "appEUI": appEUI of the interface
  • "appKey": appKey of the interface
  • "activationType": supported value: "OTAA"
  • "profile": profile of the interface
  • "encoding": (Optional) encoding used in message's payload (use /decoders APIs to define your own decoder)
  • "connectivityOptions": connectivity options used for the interface
    • "location": true/false
    • "ackUl": true/false
  • "connectivityPlan": connectivity plan to use for the interface. Should be used preferably at connectivityOptions but at least one of two shall be defined.

SMS definition:

  • "msisdn": interface phone number. Expected phone number is an international phone number : 6..15 digits starting with country code (ex. '33') and without international prefix (ex. '00'). Dummy examples of phone numbers:
    • Belgium: 32654332211
    • France: 33654332211
    • Spain: 34654332211
    • Romania: 40654332211
    • Slovakia: 421654332211
  • "serverPhoneNumber": (Optional) server phone number
  • "encoding": (Optional) name of the decoder that will be used to decode received SMS


MQTT definition:

  • "clientId": interface client ID
  • "encoding": (Optional) encoding used in message's payload (use /decoders APIs to define your own decoder)

X-CONNECTOR definition:

  • "nodeId": id used by the external connector to identify the communicating device (e.g. PUB connector/v1/nodes/{nodeId}/status)
  • "encoding": (Optional) encoding used in message's payload (use /decoders APIs to define your own decoder)

LwM2M definition:

  • "endpointName": the endpoint client name. Must comply to the format of a nodeId.
  • "security": the security information. Mandatory in creation if node is not Bootstrap managed (must be null if it is Bootstrap managed). Updated as a whole during a PATCH.
    • "mode": the security mode. Example: PSK (case sensitive)
    • "pskInfo": the pre-shared key information. Mandatory in PSK mode. Must be null in other security modes.
      • "identity": the PSK identity. Its maximum size is 128 bytes.
      • "secret": the pre-shared secret key. Must be between 16 bytes and 64 bytes and encoded in hexadecimal.
  • "bootstrap": the bootstrap information. Optional. Updated as a whole during a PATCH.
    • "managed": if true, the 'security' info will be managed by the LwM2M bootstrap operation.
  • "encoding": (Optional) encoding used in message's payload (use /decoders APIs to define your own decoder)

The activity depends on connector.

Lora activity:

  • "lastActivationTs": (Optional) last activation date of the interface
  • "lastDeactivationTs": (Optional) last deactivation date of the interface
  • "lastSignalLevel": (Optional) last signal level. " This value is a signal level computed from last uplink.
  • "avgSignalLevel": (Optional) average signal level. " This value is a signal level computed from uplinks history (PER+SNR+ESP quality indicators aggregate). " On frame counter reset, the uplinks history and average signal level are reset.
  • "lastBatteryLevel": (Optional) last battery level
  • "lastBatteryLevelTs": (Optional) date of the last battery level
  • "lastDlFcnt": (Optional) last downlink frame counter
  • "lastUlFcnt": (Optional) last uplink frame counter

SMS activity:

  • "lastUplink": (Optional) last uplink date of the interface
    • "timestamp": date of the activity
    • "serverPhoneNumber": server phone number used
  • "lastDownlink": (Optional) last downlink date of the connector node
    • "timestamp": date of the activity
    • "serverPhoneNumber": server phone number used

MQTT activity:

  • "apiKeyId": api key ID used
  • "mqttVersion": mqtt version used
  • "mqttUsername": mqtt username used
  • "mqttTimeout": mqtt timeout
  • "remoteAddress"
  • "lastSessionStartTime"
  • "lastSessionEndTime"
  • "security": security information
    • "secured":true/false
    • "protocol":(Optional) security protocol used (ex: TLSv1.2)
    • "cipher": (Optional) cipher suite (ex: TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256)
    • "clientCertAuthentication": (Optional) true/false
    • "sniHostname": (Optional) hostname provided by the Server Name Indication extension

LwM2M activity:

  • "lwm2mVersion": version of LwM2M protocol used
  • "remoteAddress": last IP used to connect to LiveObjects
  • "remotePort": last port used to connect to LiveObjects
  • "queueMode": indicator of queueMode usage
  • "bindings": last bindings parameters used
  • "registrationLifetime": registration lifetime used
  • "lastRegistrationDate": last 'Register' date
  • "lastDeregistrationDate": last 'Deregister' date
  • "lastUpdateDate": last 'Update' date
  • "lastBootstrapProvisioningDate": last time the device definition was updated by the LiveObjects bootstrap server

Note: list command are not allowed for X-Connector, MQTT and LWM2M.



Restricted to API keys with at least one of the following roles: DEVICE_R.

get.summary: Get monthly accounting metrics.
get.description:
Get accounting metrics for a given period (up to 18 months). The data is aggregated by months.

The response contains 2 main sections : tenant and months.

The tenant section gives useful information related to the customer. It returns the current values, whatever has been specified in startMonth and endMonth parameters :

  • id : Live Objects identifier
  • name : tenant name in Live Objects
  • detailed offer and options, including the display name
  • properties : custom fields


The months section provides connectors and service metrics for each month.

  • connectors section (LoRa, mqtt (device), mqtt application, http, lwm2m, sms_[server phone number],external):
    • connectors section (LoRa, mqtt (device), mqtt application, http, lwm2m, sms_[server phone number], external) :
      • traffic metrics:
        • msg: number of messages (no unit)
        • bytes: sum of the volume of all messages (unit: bytes)
        • virtualMsg: number of messages split by a size of 5kB (no unit).
          Example: 1 msg with a size of 7kB = 1 msg and 2 virtualMsg
        • msgAckRequest: Deprecated. Always 0. LoRa specific. Number of acknowledgement requests sent for uplink messages.
      • inventory metrics:
        • numberOfCommunicatingNodes: this counter is available by connector: LoRa, mqtt, sms_[server phone number] or external. It is a unique count of devices that send at least one uplink message to the platform (except for mqtt, see below). More precisely, by connector:
          • LoRa: distinct devEUIs sending an uplink
          • mqtt: distinct clientIds that have been connected at least one time
          • external: distinct nodeIds behind an external connector that have been declared online or have published a dataMessage
          • sms: distinct MSISDNs sending a message
        • numberOfActivatedNodes: LoRa specific: count of unique devices allowed to communicate and paired to the network. Corresponding LoRa status : ACTIVATED or INITIALIZED.
        • numberOfActivatedLocationNodes: LoRa specific: count of unique Activated devices that had location lora option for the month.
        • numberOfActivatedAckUlNodes: LoRa specific: count of unique Activated devices that had AckUL lora option for the month.
    • service section:
      • deviceManagement
        • numberOfSuccessfulDownloads: count of all firmware downloads in success
      • storage
        • storedDataMessagesInMB: the total size of messages stored in database. This size does not include technical data (for ex. Index). Values in MB are rounded up. The value differs from the sum of “IN” bytes sent to the platform because it includes data coming from enrichment/decoding/event processing features. This information is available from June 2019.

matchingType.description:
The Matching Type Resource specifies how the certificate or raw public key in in the Server Public Key is presented. Four values are currently defined:
0: Exact match. This is the default value and also corresponds to the functionality of LwM2M v1.0. Hence, if this resource is not present then the content of the Server Public Key Resource corresponds to this value.
1: SHA-256 hash [RFC6234]
2: SHA-384 hash [RFC6234]
3: SHA-512 hash [RFC6234]

sni.description: This resource holds the value of the Server Name Indication (SNI) value to be used during the TLS handshake.When this resource is present then the LwM2M Server URI acts as the address of the service while the SNI value is used formatching a presented certificate, or PSK identity.

certificateUsage.description:
The Certificate Usage Resource specifies the semantic of the certificate or 
raw public key stored in the Server Public Key Resource, which is used to match 
the certificate presented in the TLS/DTLS handshake. The currently defined values are 
0 for "CA constraint", 1 for "service certificate constraint", 2 for "trust anchor 
assertion", and 3 for "domain-issued certificate". When this resource is absent, 
value (3) for domain issued certificate mode is assumed. More details about the 
semantic of each value can be found in the security consideration section of the 
LwM2M specification.

dtlsTlsCiphersuite.description: When this resource is present it instructs the TLS/DTLS client to propose the indicated ciphersuite(s) in the ClientHello of the handshake. A ciphersuite is indicated as a 32-bit integer value. The IANA TLS ciphersuite registry is maintained at https://www.iana.org/assignments/tls-parameters/tls-parameters.xhtml. As an example, the TLS_PSK_WITH_AES_128_CCM_8 ciphersuite is represented with the following string "0xC0,0xA8". To form an integer value the two values are concatenated. In this example, the value is 0xc0a8 or 49320.

This is only applied until the first successful registration after a successful bootstrapping sequence. Must be 64-bit unsigned integer.

registrationFailureBlock.description: When set to true and registration to this LwM2M server fails, the LwM2M Client blocks registration to other servers in the order.When set to false, the LwM2M Client proceeds with registration to the next server in the order.

communicationSequenceDelayTimer.description: The delay between successive communication sequences. A communication sequence is defined as the exhaustion of the Communication Retry Count and Communication Retry Timer values. A communication sequence can be applied to server registrations or bootstrapping attempts. MAX_VALUE means do not perform another communication sequence. Must be 64-bit unsigned integer.

FiringRule.description: Defines if and how the matched data from MatchingRules will fire an event. You can restrict it for instance to trigger maximum 1 event per hour, or only once until you use the FiringGuard API to re-allow it. Associated to aggregationKeys, it will apply the firing type (eg 1 per hour) based on the value of these keys (eg 'streamId').

This field has no use in 'ALWAYS' firingType. For 'ONCE' or 'SLEEP' firingType, the rule will be triggerred based on the value of these keys. For instance, if aggregationKeys is set to ['streamId'] and firingType is set to 'ONCE', then only 1 event will be fired per distinct streamId.

firingType.description: Defines the type of firing mechanism : ONCE, SLEEP, or ALWAYS. If the frequency of the firing rule is defined as ONCE or SLEEP then firing guards are created in the system to prevent new generation of fired events for a given firing context, built by the aggregationKeys parameter. You can then manage these FiringGuards through dedicated APIs. SLEEP mode will automatically remove the linked FiringGuard after the duration defined by the 'sleepDuration' parameter.

sleepDuration.description: sleep duration of the FiringRule. Is defined as a ISO-8601 Period string, restricted to days, hours, minutes and seconds. 1 day will always be equivalent to 24H, regardless of daylight saving time. eg. : 'P1D', 'PT30M'. Must be set only for 'SLEEP' FiringType.

The Matching Type Resource specifies how the certificate or raw public key in in the Server Public Key is presented. Four values are currently defined:
0: Exact match. This is the default value and also corresponds to the functionality of LwM2M v1.0. Hence, if this resource is not present then the content of the Server Public Key Resource corresponds to this value.
1: SHA-256 hash [RFC6234]
2: SHA-384 hash [RFC6234]
3: SHA-512 hash [RFC6234]

certificateUsage.description:
The Certificate Usage Resource specifies the semantic of the certificate or 
raw public key stored in the Server Public Key Resource, which is used to match 
the certificate presented in the TLS/DTLS handshake. The currently defined values are 
0 for "CA constraint", 1 for "service certificate constraint", 2 for "trust anchor 
assertion", and 3 for "domain-issued certificate". When this resource is absent, 
value (3) for domain issued certificate mode is assumed. More details about the 
semantic of each value can be found in the security consideration section of the 
LwM2M specification.

dtlsTlsCiphersuite.description: When this resource is present it instructs the TLS/DTLS client to propose the indicated ciphersuite(s) in the ClientHello of the handshake. A ciphersuite is indicated as a 32-bit integer value. The IANA TLS ciphersuite registry is maintained at https://www.iana.org/assignments/tls-parameters/tls-parameters.xhtml. As an example, the TLS_PSK_WITH_AES_128_CCM_8 ciphersuite is represented with the following string "0xC0,0xA8". To form an integer value the two values are concatenated. In this example, the value is 0xc0a8 or 49320.

initialRegistrationDelayTimer.description: The delay before registration is attempted for this LwM2M Server based upon the completion of registration of the previous LwM2M Server in the registration order. This is only applied until the first successful registration after a successful bootstrapping sequence. Must be 64-bit unsigned integer.

registrationFailureBlock.description: When set to true and registration to this LwM2M server fails, the LwM2M Client blocks registration to other servers in the order.When set to false, the LwM2M Client proceeds with registration to the next server in the order.

bootstrapOnRegistrationFailure.description: If set to true, this indicates that the LwM2M Client should re-bootstrap when either registration is explicitly rejected by the LwM2M Server or registration is considered as failing as dictated by the other resource settings. If set to false, the LwM2M Client will continue with the registration attempts as dictated by the other resource settings.

communicationRetryCount.description: The number of successive communication attempts before which a communication sequence is considered as failed. Must be 64-bit unsigned integer.

communicationRetryTimer.description: The delay between successive communication attempts in a communication sequence. This value is multiplied by two to the power of the communication retry attempt minus one (2**(retry attempt-1)) to create an exponential back-off. Must be 64-bit unsigned integer.

communicationSequenceDelayTimer.description: The delay between successive communication sequences. id.description: id of the decoder. Should be null when used for POST. Required for update.

encoding.description: unique decoder name. Will be used to trigger the decoding function. To be applied, it must match exactly the data message 'metadata.encoding' field or the 'encoding' property of the device's interface.

enabled.description: decoder activation. Default is false. If disabled, the decoder will not be applied on the data messages.

model.description: if empty, the decoded data will use the value of 'model' field from encoded data. If set, this value will be used to override 'model' field in decoded data.

type.description: decoder type : csv, binary, javascript, javascript-split

template.description: decoding result optional template. Use mustache-like format. Available mustache functions : math, toUpperCase, toLowerCase. e.g. '{{#math}}{{temperature}} * 1.8 + 32{{/math}}'The template will be applied on the decoded result only if the decoder is enabled and the decoding is successful. If not set, the decoded result will be used as is.

mathEvalEnabled.description: Applying, or not, math evaluation on templated decoded result. Default is true

tags.description: tags used for description and filtering

metadata.description: decoder metadata. Read-only, set by the platform.

updated.description: date of the last update. ISO 8601 date time. Read-only, set by the platform.
